and.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eventconf_sources WHERE name = 'opennms.internal.events'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eventconf_events WHERE uei = 'uei.opennms.org/internal/opennmsStarted'

changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO eventconf_events (id, source_id, uei, event_label, description, enabled, xml_content, created_time, last_modified, modified_by, severity, event_order) SELECT nextval('eventconf_events_id_seq'), s.id, 'uei.opennms.org/internal/opennmsStarted', 'OpenNMS-defined internal event: OpenNMS started', '

OpenNMS %parm[version]% started all of its services in %parm[startupSeconds]% seconds. The previous shutdown was %parm[previousShutdown]%: clean means the previous run was stopped normally, unclean means it ended without a shutdown (for example a crash, a forced kill or a power loss), and unknown means no earlier lifecycle event was found.

', TRUE, ' uei.opennms.org/internal/opennmsStarted OpenNMS-defined internal event: OpenNMS started <p>OpenNMS %parm[version]% started all of its services in %parm[startupSeconds]% seconds. The previous shutdown was %parm[previousShutdown]%: clean means the previous run was stopped normally, unclean means it ended without a shutdown (for example a crash, a forced kill or a power loss), and unknown means no earlier lifecycle event was found.</p> OpenNMS %parm[version]% started (previous shutdown: %parm[previousShutdown]%). Normal ', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'system-migration', 'Normal', (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(e.event_order), 0) + 1 FROM eventconf_events e WHERE e.source_id = s.id) FROM eventconf_sources s WHERE s.name = 'opennms.internal.events'; UPDATE eventconf_sources SET event_count = event_count + 1, last_modified = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE name = 'opennms.internal.events';

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM eventconf_events WHERE uei = 'uei.opennms.org/internal/opennmsStarted'; UPDATE eventconf_sources SET event_count = event_count - 1 WHERE name = 'opennms.internal.events';
